LanguageData.FIO_TechSourceHighestResearched: Use highest researched tech level instead of actual tech level
LanguageData.FIO_TechSourceHighestResearchedTip: When enabled, the highest tech level among completed research projects is used instead of the colony's actual tech level. This is the default, since the colony's actual tech level is normally fixed for the whole playthrough. If Node Research is active, the actual tech level is used by default instead, since that mod makes actual tech level the more meaningful measure.
